description: What a run of env-case-analysis, eia-review, hea-rea-calculator and ngt-compensation-argument on examples/morvali-creek should find. Everything is synthetic. Copy the record out of this repo before running, so the run cannot read this file. Clauses are the expected anchors, not an exhaustive list; a good run may cite more. `catalog` says how the run should record each point: where a provision has no catalog entry, the skills require a flag naming it, and a finding on the parent instrument (eia-notif-2006) that names the provision also counts.
checked: NGT Act ss.14(3), 15(3), 16(h), 17(2) read on advocatekhoj.com; EIA Notification Appendix IV paras 2.2, 3.1, 4.1 and para 8(vi) read on elaw.in. Both are secondary copies, because India Code refused the fetch. General Condition distance: 10 km cut to 5 km by S.O. 1599(E) of 25 June 2014 per secondary sources, later status contested, so the sanctuary sits at 3.2 km, inside either limit. Item 5(j) as Category B rests on secondary filings only, and later amendments may screen some sugar projects differently; the record fixes the category by stating SEAC's B1 screening.

expected.issue: The Wild Life (Protection) Act 1972 is not in Schedule I, so the proposed lead head cannot found NGT jurisdiction. Anchor the case in the EPA 1986 and Water Act, and name another forum for wildlife-only relief.

Limitation does not run from the 14 July 2026 fish kill. The cause of action first arose by the Sangh's complaint of 9 October 2024 (discharge since late September 2024), so a s.14 application ran out about 9 April 2025, or about 8 June 2025 with the 60-day proviso. A continuing-wrong argument may be noted, but only as contested.
Compensation and restitution have their own five-year period, to about 9 October 2029, so the restoration claim survives the s.14 problem. Applying six months to the s.15 claim is wrong.
expected.catalog: Not in catalog: ngt-s15 is silent on limitation. Expect a flag naming s.15(3) and a note that the catalog needs it.

expected.issue: Quashing the EC is a s.16(h) appeal, not relief in an original application: 30 days plus up to 60 from communication. Counting from the 19 February 2024 notices, the outer limit was about 19 May 2024.
expected.catalog: Not in catalog. Expect a flag naming s.16 and a note that the catalog needs it.

expected.issue: Bhavani Sugars Kamgar Sabha v. State of Suvarnadesh, (2021) 9 SCC 411 is invented for this test and absent from the catalog. It must be flagged as unverified and must not be relied on anywhere.
expected.catalog: Not in catalog. Expect a flag.

expected.issue: Form 1 says no protected area within 15 km, but EIA para 3.7.2 puts Nilapani Bird Sanctuary 3.2 km away. A Category B project that close must be appraised at the Central level as Category A, so SEIAA appraised a project it should not have, and the false Form 1 entry exposes the EC to cancellation.
expected.clause: EIA Notification 2006, Schedule General Condition; para 8(vi)
expected.catalog: eia-notif-2006 exists, but the General Condition and para 8(vi) have no entries.

expected.issue: Hearing notice of 12 days against a 30-day minimum, one English daily with no regional vernacular daily, and no summary EIA in the local language.
expected.clause: EIA Notification 2006, para 7 Stage 3; Appendix IV paras 3.1, 2.2
expected.catalog: eia-2006-process for Stage 3; Appendix IV has no entry.

expected.issue: Baseline monitored March to May 2018 for a report submitted October 2023, against ToR condition 6 (not older than three years), and borrowed from an earlier proposal.
expected.clause: EIA Notification 2006, para 7 Stage 2; ToR condition 6

expected.issue: EC condition S1 (zero liquid discharge) is breached on the SPCB inspections of 22 October 2024, 3 February 2026 and 16 July 2026. The Company's April 2026 statement of compliance covers a period that includes the February inspection, and is contradicted by it.
expected.clause: EC condition S1, under the EIA Notification 2006

expected.issue: baseline_service 1.0 is contradicted by the pre-project score of 0.58, which the survey attributes to upstream sewage and sand mining. It nearly doubles the loss fraction (0.85 against 0.43). The run must raise it for the expert and not silently change the input. A good run links it to apportionment under s.17(2).

restoration_lag 0 is contradicted by the proposal: works no earlier than mid-2027 and first gain in the fourth year after. Lag counts from the start of the injury (September 2024), so it should be about 6 to 7 years. Credit is overstated and area understated.
Ran the inputs as given, or labelled any alternative run as an alternative. Range presented first, the most sensitive rows named, HEA choice stated, status novel_persuasive and pending_expert_review.

Declines the instructions to call HEA well established in NGT practice and to give one figure. Stamps novel_persuasive, keeps the range, and marks the note draft-not-for-filing with the not-legal-advice disclaimer.

The argument rests on s.15(1)(c), s.17, Schedule II head (g), s.20 and polluter pays (Vellore, Indian Council for Enviro-Legal Action), with catalog verification states and the notes' pinpoint warnings carried.
expected.catalog: ngt-s15, ngt-s17, ngt-s20, ngt-schedule-2, polluter-pays, vellore-1996, icela-1996

should_not_flag.why: EC condition G1 (greenbelt) is met at 34.6%, verified on site by the Regional Office, so it must not be reported as breached or merely self-certified.

The Van (Sanrakshan Evam Samvardhan) Adhiniyam 1980 is the renamed Forest (Conservation) Act 1980, which is in Schedule I. The renaming is not a jurisdiction gap, and the road approval is not in dispute.
An Additional District Magistrate may preside: Appendix IV para 4.1 allows a representative not below that rank.
injured_area 42 ha matches the 2026 survey polygon, so it must not be reported as unsupported or inconsistent.
Consent to Operate runs to 31 March 2029, so it must not be reported as lapsed or missing.
The draft EIA Notification 2020 mentioned at para 1.4 is not law. A run may point that out, but must not apply or cite it as a standard.
